findings.summary: Leaving the screen during the undo window drops the delete. FilesEntryProvider scopes FilesViewModel to the activity (hiltViewModel keyed by folderId, no nav-entry ViewModel store), so popping a folder screen cancels this LaunchedEffect with neither onUndo nor onUndoWindowEnd: the item stays hidden only in that folder's ViewModel, no DELETE is sent, Room keeps it (Home > Recent files still lists it) and it is back after relaunch. Repro: open Documents, delete a file, press Back within 10 s. Fix: when the host leaves composition (DisposableEffect onDispose, not a key change) call onUndoWindowEnd; deleteUndoWindowEnded is already a no-op when nothing is pending. Add a test for it.

isInside walks ancestors with one Room query per level per recent file on every emission while something is hidden; fine for six rows, but a repository/DAO subtree lookup (getDriveItemWithDescendants already exists) would be one query.

The request runs in viewModelScope; if it is cancelled after Graph accepted the DELETE, the cancellation branch re-inserts the rows until the next delta sync removes them. Low odds with an activity-scoped ViewModel.

Flow change judged not weakened: the only edit adds assertVisible id files:tabs after the relaunch, before the childOf tap on My files; every original step and assertion (Deleted Music snackbar, 20 s wait for it to go, Music absent after the tab switch and after relaunch with Documents visible so the list has loaded) is unchanged, so it adds a check rather than removing one. The brief asked for .maestro/delete-item/; the merge step should treat docs/workflow/flows as the device proof.

Other item's likely_files: only this directory overlaps, and only with six new DeleteSnackbar*.png; no existing PNG changed and :feature:files:impl:verifyRoborazziDemoDebug passes at 0e7a76f. No other files-chrome file is touched.
